purpose: Teach: 開運/バレル/得票/ウエート/態様/勝率/内務省/文教

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究の開運には朝の挨拶も大事だ
lines.en: Ren — morning greetings matter for research progress.
lines.style: Steady, direct instruction. Not harsh. Mentor's conviction that shows respect for the student. Measured pacing. The tone of someone who has seen this work before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。原油バレル換算の実験コストを計算します
lines.en: Yes. I'll calculate the experimental costs carefully.
lines.style: Quiet earnest commitment. No hesitation. Ren takes the feedback in fully. Soft but steady. The voice of someone writing it down in his mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会の得票結果も論文評価の参考だ
lines.en: Ren — conference feedback on your paper matters too. Pay attention to it.
lines.style: Not a lecture. More practical wisdom. Hiroshi leans slightly forward. His rhythm suggests he's lived through this—students who dismiss peer review regret it later.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験データのウエート設定を慎重にします
lines.en: Understood. I'll weight the experimental data very carefully.
lines.style: Nod in the voice. Ren absorbing, not repeating back. Slightly slower than before—he's thinking through the implication. Sincere and slightly protective of his work.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データの態様を多角的に分析しろ
lines.en: Ren — analyse your data from multiple angles. Don't trap yourself in one interpretation.
lines.style: Firmer here. Not anger—urgency. Hiroshi knows what happens when bright students confirm their own biases. Direct eye contact in the voice. A small pause after 'analyse'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説検証の勝率を上げます
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen my hypothesis testing methodology.
lines.style: Ren absorbs the correction without defensiveness. Quiet determination. He understands the stakes now. Slight breath before 'strengthen'—he means this.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、旧内務省関連の歴史資料も参照しろ
lines.en: Ren — look into the historical records from the old Home Ministry too. Don't skip that.
lines.style: Expansive here. Hiroshi seeing something in Ren's work that goes deeper. Slight warmth—this is an investment in the student's thinking. Not just instructions now; a door opening.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。文教政策研究にも興味があります
lines.en: Yes. Actually, I'm quite interested in educational policy research too.
lines.style: Ren's voice shifts. Slightly more alive. He's connecting something. Not just compliance now—genuine interest surfacing. Soft but no longer flat. The relief of being understood.
